scenes.text: Sixteen thousand six hundred and forty-seven dollars, and the hatchback is yours. But a car keeps costing money every year you own it. Fuel every week. Registration and the green slip every year. Insurance. Servicing, and new tyres now and then. These are its running costs. So is this car cheap to own, or not? You can't tell from the price.
